statements.basis: 283.15 / 286.7 / 289.5 K (40.0 / 43.5 / 46.5 bar): cold, A1 v2 relight state, warm-end coast state (300 m era)
statements.direction_at_210m: WARMER at the same launch temperature (DERIVED direction): on every 300 m record the GNC tank keeps its MECO temperature over the coast (largest change 0.0030 K), so the relight state is the launch temperature minus the ascent cooling (5.81-7.49 K over 3.26-3.80 s of ascent burn; relight 282.97-290.07 K); a 210 m ascent ends earlier (MECO on a lower predicted apogee) and cools the tank less. Upper bound: the 297.15 K ARM limit (LEAD), as the modelled tank does not warm over the coast
statements.status: MAGNITUDE MISSING until the 210 m record gives T_tank at MECO; the 300 m states stay as comparators

statements.topic: Purge vented mass against the 76 g limit (P5; OI-42)
statements.basis: M(2.5 s) <= 72.93 g and 76.05 g at 2.60 s of flow (the 2.55 s both-open cap), at the 289.5 K warm-end coast state (upper-bound flux)
statements.direction_at_210m: RISES with the relight state (DERIVED scaling, records not re-run): liquid rate +0.27 g/s per K and M(2.5 s) +0.66 g per K above 289.5 K; the 2.5 s schedule stays <= 76 g up to 294.21 K; the 2.55 s cap is at the limit at 289.5 K (76.05 g) and above it at any warmer state; at the 297.15 K ARM limit M(2.5 s) = 77.76 g and M(2.60 s) = 81.07 g
statements.status: TO-VERIFY at the 210 m warm-end relight state (GNC record) and in CF-4 (P5 read at that state); the 289.5 K "upper-bound flux" is an upper bound only for relight states <= 289.5 K
